details: All five interaction traps are handled correctly: the RAF-gated render loop decouples brush/pointer events from DOM mutations, the programmatic brush.move guard (event.sourceEvent null check) prevents infinite feedback, scales are updated each frame before use, canvas-based rendering has no transitions to interrupt, and the Pointer Events API unifies mouse and touch input. Minor inefficiency: axis DOM updates run every RAF frame unconditionally, but this does not rise to a flag-level violation.
